title: Client-anchored semantic cohort curation for quant calibration micro-packs
creator: Aisha Park
description:
Problem: Our current calibration packs skew towards global traffic patterns and under-represent client-specific semantics (e.g., niche terminology, multi-turn scaffolding) that materially affect quantization-induced distributional errors. For FP8/INT8 calibration, this produces underfitting on long-tail client behaviors and brittle accuracy regressions after rollouts.

Goal: Define a sampling and curation pipeline that produces compact, per-client/domain micro-packs (~1k–5k examples) optimized for calibration and validation. Packs should preserve semantic cluster rarity, token-length distribution, and multi-turn context shapes; include deterministic holdouts for accuracy regression detection and drift monitoring; and integrate with existing calibration runner and validation harness.

Constraints: Must be reproducible, privacy-preserving (PII redaction where needed), scalable across thousands of tenants, and compatible with existing storage/CI (S3-backed packs, manifest schema used by the calibration runner).
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can generate per-domain micro-packs with <= 5k examples and metadata manifests compatible with calibration-runner v2
Semantic rarity tiers (common / uncommon / rare) produced per pack and validated against embedding-density baseline
Holdout set (10–20%) is deterministic and flagged in the manifest for validation harness
End-to-end workflow integrated into CI such that a PR touching quant profile attaches pack metadata and a link to the generated pack
Privacy: PII detection/redaction step executes and logs a summary; no raw PII stored in pack artifacts
Automated accuracy regression tests run on every candidate quant profile using these packs with pass/fail thresholds recorded to the console dashboard
proposed_solution: Create a client-anchored curation service that builds per-domain micro-packs by combining: (1) semantic-cluster rarity sampling (using embeddings + hierarchical clustering), (2) stratified token-length bucketing, (3) prefix-preserving replay for multi-turn samples, and (4) weighted reservoir sampling to cap pack size while preserving rare signals. Produce a manifest with deterministic seeds, rarity labels, and privacy-redaction flags. Integrate pack generation as a step in the calibration pipeline and surface links in the calibration-runner job summary.
implementation_notes: Step A: Extract candidate pool for domain/client by time window (configurable; default 90 days) and apply minimal normalization (lowercasing, Unicode NFC) before embedding
Step B: Compute dense embeddings using reference encoder (encoder v1.7) and run HDBSCAN to produce clusters; estimate cluster density to assign rarity tiers
Step C: Bucketing: define token-length buckets (<=32, 33–128, 129–512, >512) and ensure each bucket's proportional representation mirrors production percentile targets with a floor for rare buckets
Step D: For multi-turn flows preserve prefix order and use prefix-preserving reservoir sampler to avoid breaking context windows
Step E: Weighted reservoir to enforce max_pack_size and upweight rare clusters by configurable factor (default x8), with deterministic RNG seeded by domain key + pipeline run id
Step F: Run PII redaction (PII-detector v2) producing redaction map and summary metrics; redact in copy used for pack but keep hashed reference in manifest for audit
Step G: Generate manifest JSON (flat fields) with versioning, seed, cluster_stats, bucket_counts, holdout_split_pct, and link to S3 artifact
Step H: Emit provenance and lineage tags consumable by CI and console (calibration-runner job id, PR link, generator commit sha)
testing_plan: Unit tests for each sampler component (reservoir, prefix-preserving, weighted upsample) with deterministic seeds
Synthetic smoke tests: generate packs from synthetic tenants with known cluster rarity distributions and assert preservation ratios
Integration: pipeline run that creates pack, pushes to S3, triggers calibration-runner, and verifies validation harness outputs stored in console
Regression: compare per-layer MSE and KL divergence metrics on representative models quantized with new packs vs baseline packs
Privacy audit: sample manifests and ensure no raw PII present; run redaction effectiveness tests
rollout_plan: Alpha: run for internal test tenants; keep packs in separate alpha bucket and require manual sign-off (owners: Rafael, Aisha)
Beta: enable for 10 low-risk external customers via opt-in; gather failure modes and size/perf telemetry
GA: enable default pack auto-generation for dedicated/private customers, opt-out available; add to onboarding docs
Backout: if regression > threshold (see metrics) for a rollout, automatic revert of quant profile deployment and notify on-call
metrics: Pack representativeness: JS divergence between production token-length histogram and pack histogram < 0.08
Coverage: fraction of semantic clusters represented >= 95% for clusters that exceed 0.01% traffic
Validation sensitivity: ability to detect known-introduced 0.5% token-level degradation with >= 80% power
End-to-end latency: pack generation median < 12 minutes for domains with 100k candidates
PII redaction false-negative rate < 0.01% on sampled audits
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Park: Created initial ticket. Proposed approach emphasizes semantic rarity and prefix-preserving replay based on discussion with Applied ML. Added HDBSCAN + reservoir as a strawman.

2026-03-11 - Rafael Gomez: Reviewed. Agree on preserving prefix order for multi-turn. Need to validate cost of embedding computation for large tenants; propose cached embedding frontier for heavy clients.
2026-03-11 - Priya Singh: (ML) Suggest using cosine-similarity based density estimate instead of plain HDBSCAN for very noisy embedding spaces; can add fallback to k-means for small windows.

2026-03-12 - Security (Marco Li): Flagged PII redaction requirement and requested sample manifests for audit. Also asked for plan to encrypt pack artifacts at rest with customer KMS for private deployments.

2026-03-12 - Aisha Park: Added acceptance criteria for integration with calibration-runner job summaries and CI attachment requirement.
